catalysts.name: KRONOS MMR construction permit — NRC review
catalysts.description: The University of Illinois submitted the CPA on Mar 31, 2026; the NRC accepted it May 18 and began formal review Jun 23, with ~12 months expected. Management targets initial construction in H2 2027. A permit issuance would be the first hard de-risking of the reactor program.

risks: Pre-revenue: the reactor business has no sales, and the first construction is H2 2027 at the earliest. The Secured Transportation Systems acquisition adds a small logistics revenue line only.
Long fuse: the NRC permit decision is ~mid-2027, so there is no reactor binary inside a typical 30-day turbo window — the score here rests on survival and valuation, not timing.
Spending ramps ahead of revenue: $297.6M went into investing activities in the nine months to Jun 30, 2026. Cash will decline from ~$580M, and the next 10-K (Nov 30 update) will show by how much.
Advanced-nuclear sentiment is volatile and rate-sensitive: the stock is ~79% below its $49.50 high, and higher rates compress long-duration, pre-revenue valuations most.
Analyst targets are stale and falling: consensus (~$37–45) dates from $13–25 share prices, and the most recent cut was to $19.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Microreactor names move on NRC/DOE milestone headlines rather than drifting into dates. NNE rose ~45% over 10 days when the NRC accepted the KRONOS CPA (May 2026), then gave it all back in the sector selloff.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Milestone headlines are unscheduled; Nov 30 update is the near-term dated event

postWin.note: NNE gained ~45% in 10 days on the NRC CPA acceptance (May 2026); the SMR sector typically reacts ~+15% on regulatory milestones (H1 2026). A permit issuance in 2027 would be a bigger step.

postLose.note: NNE fell ~8% over 69 days even after the NRC docketed the CPA (Sep 2026) and ~74% from its $60.87 high in H1 2026 — good regulatory news has not protected the stock from sector de-ratings.

spotSizing.reason: 2.5%. regulatory_approval sits at +5.8pp medianExcess vs +7.7pp overall (n=23), a -1.9pp gap that does not reach the 2pp laggard bar. Lane-wide prior governs; macro WAIT keeps size low.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-20%). Below ~$7.90 the market is discounting a burn or timeline surprise.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If the Nov 30 update shows a big cash drop with no NRC progress, or the NRC review slips past 2027, exit.
